title: AI Assisted Interactive Segmentation of Cryo-Electron Tomography Data
content: Advances in cryo-electron tomography (cryoET) have enabled the study of complex biological systems by visualizing subcellular structures at nanometer scale. Improvements in data collection throughput have facilitated large scale quantitative analyses of tomograms, contributing to our understanding of the mechanisms underlying diseases [1]. However, a key requirement to mine these insights across hundreds or potentially thousands of tomograms is the development of automated systems capable of analyzing data at scale. While progress has been made in building Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods for accurate segmentation of organelles in cryoET data [2], they typically need expertly annotated 3D volumes for each structure of interest – a process that can be time-consuming and does not scale well if bespoke models have to be built for each new use case.
